name: supervisor-unattended
description: The owner configures the supervisor, queues one trigger, and serves until idle from the owner copy (the copy inside the checkout refuses): the scripted worker drives the installed CLI through build, independent verification, the executable release, and learning; the supervisor meters the transcript, audits the ledger, and reports the job done. A repeated trigger is a harmless duplicate.

steps.note: the project is a git checkout with runtime output ignored
steps.python:
import pathlib, subprocess
pathlib.Path('.gitignore').write_text('.agentic-team/runs/\n.agentic-team/CURRENT.md\n.agentic-team/supervisor/\n__pycache__/\n', encoding='utf-8')
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', 'add', '-A'], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-c', 'user.email=o@example.com', '-c', 'user.name=Owner', 'commit', '-q', '-m', 'install'], check=True)

steps.note: nothing launches without an aggregate allowance; the owner sets one
the same trigger again is a harmless duplicate
serve acts with the owner's token, so the copy inside the checkout refuses it
the owner runs serve from the owner copy outside the checkout (supervise owner-copy prints its path)
steps.python:
import subprocess, sys
alias = [sys.executable, '.agentic-team/bin/agentic_team.py', 'supervise']
copy = subprocess.run(alias + ['owner-copy', '--project', '.'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1]
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, copy, 'serve', '--until-idle', '--max-seconds', '120', '--project', '.'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert result.returncode == 0, (result.returncode, result.stdout[-400:], result.stderr[-400:])
assert '| `greeting-fix` | manual | done |' in result.stdout, result.stdout[-600:]

steps.note: the run went through learning to completion without a human click
